title: ARSENAL PAID A REPORTED £75M. ARTETA STILL WANTS MORE FROM BRUNO
description:
£75m reported, and Arteta still wants more close-range goals.

Bruno Guimaraes is first choice at Arsenal now, after a slow start. He ranks near the top for ground duels, behind only Romeo Lavia. He has scored against Sunderland and Leeds. Arteta still says he's not there yet. Apparently £75m doesn't cover tap-ins.

On Saturday at 5:30pm UK time he visits his old house, St James' Park, where he scored 31 league goals for Newcastle, nine of them last season. They remember.

Is Arteta right to keep pushing, or is that harsh? Tell us which side you're on.
